programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Carmen llega con Roro al bar Garibaldi, ella no quiere irse hasta que Manuel oiga cantar al Chiquillo. El coloso, furioso, le pide a Carmen que se vaya. Roro se subirá a la tarima a cantar, el Coloso quedara atónito al escuchar a su hijo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rodrigo Román alias el Monumental continua ganándose el corazón del Coloso cantando en tarima. Por otro lado, el capitán Bernal y sus hombres llegan al bar Garibaldi con la fotografía del fugitivo Emiliano Sanchez Gallardo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario queda destrozada al ver la fotografía del fugitivo Emiliano Sanchez. Fernando al ver la foto corre a cogerla para ocultarla. Emiliano tratara de explicarle a Rosario lo que pasa pero ella, furiosa, le pedirá que se aleje para siempre de ella.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario continúa destrozada por la noticia que recibió por parte de la policía y decide quedarse encerrada. Por otro lado, Emiliano alista el traje de mariachi para devolverlo. El mexicano renuncia en el bar diciendo que se va para su país.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro reacciona mal luego de haber pasado la noche con Clementina. Clementina se siente culpable y rompe su compromiso con Pepe. Matilde decide ir a buscar a Leandro y ambos aclaran el malentendido. Rodrigo le pide a Pello que lo ayude a vengarse.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Con ayuda de Pello, Rodrigo sorprende a Miriam y Arturo. Rodrigo los amarra a todos, incluyendo a Pello. Arturo escapa y va por la policía. Momentos después, Miriam se rinde y decide irse con Rodrigo. Leandro y Matilde encaran a Hugues y a Moisés.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Clementina le revela a Leandro que está embarazada y él le ofrece criar juntos a su hijo, pero ella se niega. Matilde se entera del estado de salud de Remedios y busca a Leandro para llevarlo con ella.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: A pesar de las súplicas, Matilde termina su relación con Leandro. Moisés intenta acercarse de nuevo a Matilde, pero ella lo rechaza y queda resentido. Leandro le propone a Clementina formar una familia.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro convence a Reinaldo de viajar con él para grabar la última canción del disco. Al regresar, Leandro pide a Dios por su hijo ante la amenaza de que nazca ciego. Se estrena el disco de Leandro y Clementina da a luz.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Es la última noche de Emiliano en La Laguna, les confiesa a sus compañeros que su reconciliación con Rosario fue un éxito. Mientras Carlos recibe una sorpresa por parte de Eulalia en el camerino, que hará que él se sienta muy orgulloso de ella.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le tiene una gran sorpresa a Rosario, le da un anillo y le pide matrimonio por segunda vez, en esta oportunidad como Emiliano Sánchez Gallardo. Mientras el licenciado Corona llega a Bogotá y hace contacto con el detective.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se encuentra con Corona en la casa para saber de una vez por todas que quiere con él, pero primero pide saber sobre el estado de su madre y su hermana. Mientras Rosario y sus compañeros, oran porque este encuentro salga bien.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano totalmente deprimido, todo fue una mentira y no pudo ver a su madre, no ve una salida para su gran problema y recuperar lo suyo. La muerte de Martin sigue sin tener una claridad y cada vez se ve más lejos que la verdad salga a la luz.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Coloso se entera que Francisco vuelve a Plaza Garibaldi y amenaza con irse si eso sucede. Mientras la mamá de Rosario se presenta a La Laguna y le pide a Francisco que no vaya hacer sufrir a su hija nuevamente.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se reencuentra con su mamá. Corona espera que Emiliano cumpla lo que él le ordenó. Por otra parte, Rosario está decidida a afrontar lo que se atraviese en su relación con Emiliano.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia está decepcionada de mamá Vila y de todo lo que pasa, regresa a su casa a Valledupar con Vilma, mientras Diomedes la busca en casa de los Arjona, Diomedes les cuenta la verdad a medias. El mono pelea con Diomedes.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes encara a Lucia, ella recuerda las palabras de su amiga Estefanía y le dice que lo va a pensar, el Mono Arjona le insiste a Dumar que investigue cosas concretas. Lucia aparece y le dice a Diomedes que se queda con muchas condiciones

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia llega a Carrizal y habla con Elvira, se porta seca y grosera, luego habla con los Arjona. Diomedes promete a sus suegros que no la volverá a hacer sufrir, el mono no puede creer lo que escucha. Beatriz aconseja a Lucia que no deje a Diomedes.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Dumar confirma al mono Arjona que la hija de Yurleidis es de Diomedes y que tiene muchos más hijos en la calle. El mono llega a casa de Diomedes y al verlo lo golpea.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes sufre por la indiferencia de Lucia, ella lo sigue tratando con desprecio, con la idea de sacarle dinero. Diomedes tiene una presentación en pleno festival de orquestas.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes se baja de la tarima y Joaco lo recibe feliz por la acogida que tuvo con la gente. Lucia sigue escuchando a su amiga Estefanía y le dice que siga con Diomedes solo por la plata, Diomedes recibe el Congo de oro en el Carnaval de Barranquilla.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se sumerge nuevamente en la depresión y le pide a Rosario que salga de su vida, pero el amor que ella y él sienten se pondrá nuevamente a prueba. Fernando llega a la cantina y le dice a Rosario que está con ellos.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El fuego del amor de Rosario y Emiliano es muy fuerte y afronta todo obstáculo. Por otro lado, el padre de Emiliano lo ayudará de la manera menos esperada.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Lara llega nuevamente a Plaza Garibaldi y sólo falta un pequeño reencuentro con El Coloso, quien decide llamar al esposo de Mireya para darle una lección por haberla golpeado. Una gran noticia está por llegar a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano y Rosario salen mal librados del encuentro con Roberto y Gabriela, quienes desaprueban a Rosario por su condición. Por otro lado, Emiliano intenta mejorar su relación con Raquel de Guerrero.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano negocia con Carlos Malagón para que le pague lo mismo que a los otros mariachis. Eulalia quiere cantar a dúo con Lara y le pide a Mireya que convoque al grupo para ensayar. Por otro lado, Emiliano se reúne con Corona y los mafiosos.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Leticia queda destrozada al ver a Andrés en una librería con su esposa embarazada. Por otro lado, Eulalia le anuncia al grupo de mariachis la presentación de ella y las coreografías que necesita. El grupo se muestra furioso.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro se propone darle su apellido al bebé, pero Clementina le recuerda que no es posible porque no están casados. Todos celebran el éxito de Leandro con su disco de oro. Arturo y Gerardo evitan encontrarse con Julio Pantoja e inventan una excusa.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro sorprende a Clementina con una nueva canción el día de su boda. Luego, celebran el bautizo del bebé. Arturo pone a Evaristo de su lado. Leandro llega a Pajales con su mujer y su hijo para pasar el año nuevo.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton. Shortly before leaving their hotel they mention they haven't been able to find what they're looking for; "something old and derelict that they can do up." Anne Merrick tells them about Winyard, a tumbledown cottage in the woods, might be for sale. At the estate agents they are told the house is not yet available for viewing. Later that evening they find the house on their own. However, Caroline has read up on the cottage's haunted reputation and only reluctantly explores it with Peter. The next morning they are found strangled in their own car. DCI Barnaby starts the investigation with the help of PC Ben Jones and they come across the world of estate agents, identical twins, ghosts, piano wire, and more before another body turns up.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Midsomer Barton are all set to celebrate Oak Apple Week, especially as the carnival queen event is set to return after an eight year absence. Yet the body of the mother of a deceased, one-time carnival queen, found in a stream, looks set to spoil things, as Barnaby and Jones find themselves digging up the past. From familiar faces, to drunken boasts and hidden obessions, it slowly becomes clear that the mother's daughter might be the key to solving the murder, when more deaths follow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Wealthy, eccentric and obese aristocrat Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives at Haddington Hall to make an announcement. Although George Bullard is adamant his death is from natural causes, the case is far from simple when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in a house fire shortly afterwards and Freddy's will goes missing. Barnaby and Jones find themselves investigating the extended Butler family, uncovering hidden secrets, illegitimate children and elusive treasure in the process.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Martin Barrett, a local council clerk living in Midsomer Worthy, is murdered during the night by shotgun, prompting Barnaby and Jones to find a motive for his murder. When they discover that Barrett was an expert blackmailer, his victims become prime suspects for his death - from a local pub landlord, a cleaner, a prominent member of the police board, to a former marine geologist. As they investigate, finding themselves drawn to the seaside, they slowly uncover deception, theft, attempted blackmail and hatred.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Broughton, a ninety-year-old battle of the sexes has often occurred, with men trying to oppose an event that the women have managed to successfully hold without interruption, until it culminates with casualties on both sides - Mildred Danvers, an elderly woman who had returned on the day of a funeral and poisoned in her hotel room, and Rev. Anthony Gant, shot during a major event being held in the village green, in view of many. It soon becomes clear someone may have wished to kill both to cover up a dark truth, and soon Barnaby has to figure out who amongst the village wanted both dead, complicated further when Gant's curate is murdered next.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers in Elverton-cum-Latterly are up in arms and divided, over the building of a supermarket. Things soon come to a head when independent environmental supervisor, Frank Hopkirk, is found stabbed to death at a Jubb's Timber Yard, the site of the new supermarket, by a pair of children. When Barnaby and Jones investigate to determine who wanted Hopkirk dead, they find out that he secretly came to the village under various aliases for sexual rendezvous with various women in fantasy role-playing scenarios, and that he had been making further investigations on the future development site and having doubts over claims it was contaminated. Either someone didn't like his investigations, or someone didn't like his sexual appetite, but either way, Barnaby finds himself investigating lies and more to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and DC Ben Jones (Jason Hughes) find themselves attempting to unravel the deaths of a choir tenor, and later a bird watcher, before more murders occur. The case is complicated by a rivalry between the Midsomer Worthy and Aston Wherry choirs, due to compete in an upcoming competition, and suspicions that an art scam is to be conducted, and soon Barnaby and Jones become concerned about a local woman, who they fear may become a victim herself. Particularly when it becomes clear the bird watcher had been photographing suspicious activity of late.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A few months ago, Annie Woodrow was arrested, accused of murdering her friend, Frances Trevelyan, on the motive of wanting Frances' husband. Her time in court has come, but DCI Barnaby is certain she still is holding things back in regards to the murder, and decides to monitor the trial. Yet a chance remark by Frances' youngest daughter, and a meeting with an old friend and psychiatrist, makes him begin to doubt the evidence for her conviction. Soon he and DC Jones, awaiting news of his promotion to DS, find themselves reinvestigating the case, and it soon becomes clear that they may have missed details that could implicate another in the murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a survivalist is found murdered in his bombproof shelter, Barnaby unravels a dark conspiracy to reveal how far people will go to escape the end of the world.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Pastry chef Chrissie Larkton's mill has been in her family for centuries. She restored it and turned it into a thriving online business, but the popularity has overshadowed Lower Blissingham, and many of the villagers are not happy about it.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Elverton-Cum-Latterly battle in the Dominoes Competition that dates back decades, but when the event occurs the same night as a drag queen fundraiser for a terminally ill teenager, it results in a deadly clash of cultures.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.desc: Nothing But A Winner chronicles the rise of the University of Alabama's legendary football dynasty, shaped by Coaches Bear Bryant and Nick Saban. programme.title: Brad Upton
programme.desc: Brad Upton first stepped on stage in September of 1984 and he's never looked back. This ex-grade school teacher is now in his 30th year of comedy and is nearing 6000 lifetime performances. He is a past winner of the Las Vegas Comedy Festival and appeared recently at Caesar's Palace as part of the HBO Comedy Festival. He has spent the last eight years as the opening act for the legendary Johnny Mathis and did multiple shows all over the country with the late, great Joan Rivers. He has also been seen in concert with The Smothers Brothers, Smokey Robinson, Kenny Rogers, Dolly Parton, Lewis Black, George Jones, Glen Campbell, Pam Tillis and many others. Coast to coast all over North America isn't the only place Brad performs. In 2014 Brad headlined in Singapore, Hong Kong, The MGM in Macau and did eight nights in Israel as part of the Comedy for Koby benefit. His new CD entitled, "Brad Uptonogood" is heard regularly on Sirius Satellite Radio and is available online wherever music is sold. He also just released his first DVD entitled, "Brad Upton, Live from the 509".

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Andy Woodhull
programme.desc: Andy recently appeared on Conan on TBS. Around that same time, his half-hour special premiered on Comedy Central. He was the first comedian to make his network television debut on “The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon”. He also appeared on Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen, and Gotham Comedy Live on AXS. He had also appeared on Comedy Central's “Live at Gotham” in 2009.

programme.title: Cory Michaelis
programme.desc: A teacher by day and comic by night, Cory Michaelis keeps his act edgy enough to keep the audience from feeling like they're in his 10th grade History class. He cleverly tells short stories and jokes that try to get audiences to think but are silly and absurd as well. Cory is a regular in all of the clubs in the Pacific Northwest and has headlined clubs, colleges, casinos, and weird bars all over the country. He didn't win the 2013 World Series of Comedy (semi-finals), the 2012 Seattle International Comedy Competition (SICC), or the 2014 Tacoma Comedy Contest (2nd) but he took another crack at the SICC and made the 2014 finals.

programme.title: Kristin Key
programme.desc: Kristin Key grew up a minister's daughter in a small town in West Texas. Much like Footloose, she was raised in a no-drinking, no-dancing, no instrumental music environment. She seemed like any other well-behaved girl… until she opened her mouth. It was obvious from the beginning that she had a quick wit and undeniable sense of humor.

programme.title: Tommy Drake
programme.desc: Tommy's unique mixture of original material delivered in a classic style has given him the opportunity to do more shows and be seen by more people live than just about any other comic on the planet.

programme.title: Chad Thornsberry
programme.desc: Chad Thornsberry was born in St. Louis, MO. From an early age he learned his family was blessed, and blessed him with humor, quick wit, and a love of storytelling. Chad's unique comedic perspective awards audience the opportunity to laugh at the common occurrences in everyday life. Often referred to as a great writer, his straightforward style allows audiences to laugh with him and at him as they find the humor in themselves. With reflections on growing up in a trailer park and observations as an English teacher, Chad's satiric insights look at the pitfalls that make us human. With smart humor and a conversational style, Chad has delighted audiences from the trailer park, throughout the Midwest, and from coast to coast.

programme.title: Ron Ruhman

programme.title: Byron Trimble
programme.sub-title: Diary of a Short City Boy
programme.desc: Byron Trimble has traveled around the world doing comedy for conferences, churches, retreats, clubs, schools, and corporate events. He has been featured on NBC, ABC, Living Oklahoma, and the Dan Patrick Show. His hilarious blend of music and comedy in his live shows and the following generated by his online videos have enabled him to share the stage with nationally known comedians like John Crist and Anita Renfroe. Raised in Detroit, MI, he now lives in Tulsa, OK with his beautiful wife, Hannah, and three young children. Yet, he says his greatest success might be being a pastors kid his whole life and never being arrested.

programme.title: Franklin and Friends
programme.desc: "Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. The series tackles issues that include personal empowerment, socialization, self-esteem, appreciation of nature and school issues.

She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.22

Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.23

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.24

Impressed by Jeongi's skill, Inbin requests that if Jeongi crafts a medicine bowl that fully satisfies Prince Shinseong, she be officially appointed a master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.26

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN!

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: Confucius, Buddha, Jesus, and Muhammad

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.sub-title: Hunting, Gathering, and Stone Age Cooking
programme.desc: Food as a major catalyst in human history; what food choices reveal about one's values and ambitions; studying food culture in prehistoric times; a wide-ranging diet; the ways in which how human ancestors ate directly drove evolution.

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.desc: The transition to agriculture; exploring the factors surrounding the rise of agriculture; how plants and animals were domesticated; why agriculture directly led to civilization; how the menu of foods favored by agricultural societies came about.

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.sub-title: Egypt and the Gift of the Nile
programme.desc: Ancient Egypt's prosperity and advantages; a sophisticated food tradition and the first elite cuisine; the archeological evidence of Egypt's food customs; the religious significance of foodstuffs and animals; the components of Egyptian cuisine.

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.sub-title: Ancient Judea - From Eden to Kosher Laws
programme.desc: Why practices regarding food were integral to the lives of the ancient Hebrews; exploring prescriptions regarding food in Genesis; considering that the Fall was an act of eating; Hebrew rituals and the meaning of sacrifice; complex food prohibitions.

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.sub-title: Classical Greece - Wine, Olive Oil, and Trade
programme.desc: How the ancient Greeks' need for arable land led to their imperial and mercantile systems; what can be learned about ancient Greek food culture; the role of food in rituals; classical Greek diet components that later influenced the rest of the world.

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.sub-title: The Alexandrian Exchange and the Four Humors
programme.desc: Alexander's conquests herald an era where previously unconnected cultures mix; tracing the diffusion of foodstuffs over trade networks in the Hellenistic period; studying early dietary regimens based on Galen's famous theory of the body's humors.

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.sub-title: Ancient India - Sacred Cows and Ayurveda
programme.desc: Ancient India's culinary traditions carry a wide influence; learning about the culture of the Aryans, whose religion prefigures Hinduism; food customs relating to caste and the traditions of vegetarianism in Hinduism, Jainism, and Buddhism.

programme.title: Food: A Cultural Culinary History
programme.sub-title: Yin and Yang of Classical Chinese Cuisine
programme.desc: Chinese culture produces what is arguably the most complex and varied culinary tradition on Earth; tracing the rise of civilization in China from the Hsia to the Han dynasty; the social and technological factors underlying China's food traditions.

programme.title: Understanding Japan: A Cultural History
programme.sub-title: Japan: A Globally Engaged Island Nation
programme.desc: Japanese culture is shaped by powerful cycles of globalization and isolation; the earliest human habitation of Japan; the origins of its rich culture; the perfect starting points for dispelling common Western misconceptions about this island nation.

programme.title: Understanding Japan: A Cultural History
programme.desc: An introduction to ancient Japanese myths, collectively known as Shinto; the oldest written compilation of Japanese oral tradition, the Kojiki; stories about gods and heroes; the origins of the universe, the Rock Cave of Heaven and rival clans.

programme.title: Understanding Japan: A Cultural History

programme.title: Understanding Japan: A Cultural History

programme.title: Understanding Japan: A Cultural History
